structured_output.summary: Added a pure shout() function and wired a --shout flag through main(); tests cover both the plain and shouted paths.

decisions.fork: What should the new pure function's signature be — transform a name, or transform arbitrary text?
decisions.chosen: shout(text) uppercases a string and composes as shout(greet(name))
decisions.rejected: a variant like shout_greet(name) that duplicates the f-string formatting from greet()
decisions.why: keeps greet() as the single source of the greeting format and makes shout a generic, reusable transform

structured_output.verify:
python3 greet.py ada --shout   # -> HELLO, ADA
python3 greet.py ada           # -> hello, ada
python3 -m unittest -q         # 2 tests, OK
